title: Transect: Making large-scale agentic evaluations easier to understand
headline: UK AISI releases Transect tool for agentic AI evaluation transcripts
summary: The UK AI Security Institute has released Transect, an open-source Python package designed to translate complex agentic AI evaluation transcripts into interactive reports. The tool helps reviewers examine agent behaviours, multi-agent collaboration, token use, and automated judgements on a shared timeline. It aims to improve transparency and oversight for long, autonomous AI evaluation runs.
why_it_matters: Organisations conducting complex AI safety evaluations can use Transect to inspect model-generated activity labels and multi-agent interactions against underlying transcripts, supporting more robust verification.

quotes.text: To address these issues, with the support of Meridian Labs , we are releasing Transect , an open-source Python package built on Inspect Scout . It translates the complexities of an agentic evaluation transcript into one interactive report.

Transect links model-generated labels to the transcript and records how they were produced. When an analysis uses repeated judgements or several judge models, reviewers can see where those judgements disagree.

classification.significance_reason: Provides practical tooling and methodology for evaluating and auditing complex agentic AI systems, aligning with growing international interest in rigorous frontier AI assurance.
